description: OpenCode plugin that injects secrets from ~/.config/opencode/secrets.env into process.env at startup, hot-reloads them on change, and reconnects MCP servers so they pick up new values. Works with both OpenCode V1 and V2.

detail.description_zh: OpenCode 插件，在启动时将 ~/.config/opencode/secrets.env 中的秘密注入 process.env，在更改时热重载它们，并重新连接 MCP 服务器以便它们获取新值
